name: Mento Dollar
oneLiner: USDm is Mento's oracle-priced dollar stablecoin on Celo and Monad (formerly cUSD), backed by the live Mento reserve and CDP/liquidity infrastructure.
collateral: Mento reserve holding AUSD, sUSDS, CELO, USDT, EURC, USDC, stETH, and ETH; reserve composition is pulled from the live Mento reserve API and changes over time.
pegMechanism: Mento V3 reserve-backed model: users mint and redeem USDm against reserve assets through Mento rails, with oracle pricing, circuit breakers, and reserve governance replacing the old CDP framing.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-30. Material supply is Celo (~87%) plus Monad (~12%). On Celo at block 73547284 the USDm proxy 0x765d…282a resolves via Celo Proxy _getImplementation() and EIP-1967 to StableTokenV3 0x8157…c318 (Sourcify exact-match), owner/_getOwner 0x5809…Ba458 (Mento Safe). StableTokenV3 exposes owner-gated setOperator/setBurner and onlyBurner burn(address,uint256) which destroys an arbitrary holder balance without allowance, plus onlyOperator sendToPool/returnFromPool which transfer arbitrary holder balances without allowance — direct individual freeze/seize reach on the canonical deployment. Ordinary transfer/transferFrom remain unmodified ERC-20; no pause/isBlacklisted selectors. On Monad at block 91740878 proxy 0xbc69…0115 uses StableTokenSpoke impl 0x6a8f…e62e with owner the same Safe, setBurner present, and live EIP-1967 admin 0x97b2…5ef5 (upgrade path under the same control domain). Peripheral bridge rows (Ethereum Moss, Solana/NEAR Allbridge, Klaytn Orbit dust) are separate failure domains and not required for the material freeze verdict. Reserve USDC/USDT exposure is additional upstream risk, not the token-level control path.

sources.label: USDm Celo token owner() re-read 2026-07-16 = 4-of-6 Mento Safe

review.evidence: At Celo block 69286148, Safe API (celo chain) confirmed 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 has threshold 4, 6 owners, no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99, masterCopy 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762 (Safe L2 v1.4.1). isMinter(Broker 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) = true. Monad confirmed at block 80,612,848: same Safe address is owner, threshold 4, 7 signers (including one additional signer not on Celo). NEAR: parent account a11bd.near is a plain EOA (no contract, ~11.69 NEAR, no lock) controlling the bridge subaccount cusd.token.a11bd.near; no owner view method exposed. USDm (Mento Dollar) reserve backing is published only on Mento's own reserve dashboard (self-verification, no independent third-party attestor), so reconciliation is unknown, and no financial regulator supervises the Mento protocol, so supervision is none. Unlike the Mento FX variants whose token owner is the 48-hour Mento Timelock, the USDm Celo token owner re-read on 2026-07-16 is the 4-of-6 Mento Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 with no execution delay, and the NEAR deployment is minted by a plain EOA (a11bd.near); the mint admin is therefore self-controlled with no independent delay, so the encoding-derived unbounded cap is not superseded and no raiseable escape is earned. 2026-07-21 gap-fill pass: resolved the upgrade-authority structural gap directly on-chain via forno.celo.org at Celo block 72722357. USDm/cUSD on Celo is not a standard EIP-1967 transparent/UUPS proxy — both the canonical minus-1 implementation slot and the raw (un-decremented) 'eip1967.proxy.implementation' hash slot read zero. The deployed bytecode instead implements Celo's own Proxy.sol pattern, which exposes explicit getters; calling _getImplementation() (selector 0x42404e07) returned implementation 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318, and _getOwner() (selector 0xf7e6af80) returned 0x58099b74f4acd642da77b4b7966b4138ec5ba458 — the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe already established as the mint/Broker administrator. The Safe can therefore both authorize Broker minters and replace the token implementation outright, with no separate timelock on the upgrade path.

routes.reviewNote: Native Mento cUSD on Celo; mint authority is the Mento Broker under the 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 4-of-6 Safe (isMinter(Broker 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) = true, per the mint-authority review). DefiLlama records Celo cUSD as issued.

NEAR cUSD is the Allbridge representation cusd.token.a11bd.near: the token contract mints under Allbridge cross-chain messages and is administered by the a11bd.near account (a plain EOA, no contract code, per the mint-authority review's NEAR RPC reads). Supply is dust in the capture.

Mento USDm is issued natively on Monad (DefiLlama records Monad cUSD as issued): owner() of the Monad USDm proxy = the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 (mint-authority review, Monad block 80,612,848). Not a bridge representation.

Ethereum cUSD supply is split across three bridged variants: moss ecUSD 0x9b9E2De4cB4ca479943F36DfFc72c7253bb1f66a (totalSupply $1.85M, the largest), Optics cUSD 0xd8F3208c045DD69D27938346275165998359D8fF ($615k, owner = Optics BridgeRouter 0x4fc16de11deac71e8b2db539d82d93be4b486892), and wCUSD 0xad3E3Fc59dff318BecEaAb7D00EB4F68b1EcF195 ($157k). This row records the dominant variant: minter() on ecUSD = 0x9719d81c506c95f92caf970851b22afc88aee574, a 1,581-byte Moss bridge minter contract (owner 0x4195530d44c96875199fb03525dcb0f22e151f97), read 2026-07-20.

Solana cUSD is the Allbridge SPL token (9 decimals, supply 28,172,442,622,415 raw, read 2026-07-20 via Solana RPC) with mintAuthority CYEFQXzQM6E5P8ZrXgS7XMSwU3CiqHMMyACX4zuaA2Z4 — a program-derived Solana account (owned by the System Program, no executable code) consistent with Allbridge's program mint authority; DefiLlama labels this deployment 'allbridge'.

Klaytn cUSD is the Orbit Bridge representation 'Orbit Bridge Klaytn CUSD' (totalSupply $5.52 dust, read 2026-07-20). The token exposes no enumerable minter or owner views and Orbit Bridge has been defunct since its December 2023 exploit, so the mint authority cannot be honestly established; the route stays unresolved.

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer-run reserve API was re-read on 2026-07-27 and reported $18,784,067.026359823 of collateral across 17 chain-level positions (reported percentages sum to 99.1%; weights below are normalized to 100). The reviewed grouping combines the same stablecoin family across chains and retains every positive category: AUSD, sUSDS, CELO, USDT/USDT0, EURC/axlEUROC, USDC/axlUSDC, stETH, and ETH. The ETH slice merges the plain ETH position on Ethereum with the WETH residual on Celo, matching the live Mento adapter's merged ETH identity. Each tracked stablecoin exposure has an exact collateral edge; CELO, stETH, and ETH remain explicit exogenous collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-run Mento Reserve API values grouped by stablecoin family; USDm is reserve-backed under Mento's documented model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every positive reserve API category is either linked to its tracked stablecoin family or explicitly dispositioned as an exogenous cryptoasset.

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDm is a USD-pegged reserve-backed stablecoin designed for payments and cross-border transfers, meeting the GENIUS Act's functional definition of a payment stablecoin. The issuing entity (Mento Labs GmbH) is a German GmbH domiciled in Berlin with no identified US operations, subsidiary, or regulatory presence. The protocol is governed by Mento DAO (MENTO token holders) with a 4/7 multisig Safe as the Celo token owner. Market focus is Africa and emerging markets (MiniPay in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana). Market cap ~$14M as of June 2026.

foreignExceptionEvidence.summary: No foreign-issuer registration or comparability determination has been sought by Mento Labs GmbH. The issuer has made no public statements about pursuing GENIUS Act compliance or OCC foreign-issuer registration. GENIUS foreign-issuer rules remain in proposed-rules phase as of June 2026.

genius.notes: The shortlisting rationale cited a named US-nexus issuer (Mento Labs) but this is factually incorrect — Mento Labs GmbH is domiciled in Berlin, Germany. USDm meets the functional definition of a payment stablecoin (USD-peg, reserve-backed, designed for payments) but the issuer is a foreign entity with no US regulatory engagement. The GENIUS Act foreign-issuer pathway could theoretically apply when the framework is effective, but no steps toward compliance have been taken. Conservative status: no-public-authorization-found.
